title: A scheduled agent
description: A brain's scheduled agent, one file each: <brain>/.brain/schedules/<name>.json (docs/BRAINS.md, Scheduled agents). The file's name is the agent's. A new or changed file waits for the owner's approval on the Schedules page; until then the approved version runs, or nothing does.

name.description: The agent's name, unique in the brain: the file's name, which it must match. A file may leave it out; brain.json's entries need it.

when.description: "every 6h", "daily 07:00", "weekly mon 09:00" or a cron expression ("cron 0 7 * * 1-5"), in the bridge's time zone.

enabled.description: Run on the schedule. Default true; Run now works either way.

description.description: What it is for, one line.

prompt.description: The task, inline. At most one of prompt, prompt_file, template and command; none is the file schedules/<name>.md.

prompt_file.description: A file in the brain's folder that holds the task.

template.description: A built-in task: memory-consolidation, morning-briefing, code-review-security, code-review-bugs, code-review-simplify.

command.description: A program the bridge runs on a node through its exec capability, instead of a brain run.

argv.description: The program and its arguments; no shell.

dir.description: The working directory on the node.

vars.description: Fill {{name}} in the template or prompt file.

report.description: Where the result goes: always to the chat, only when worth reporting (the default), or nowhere (kept in the history and log).

chat.description: The chat the result goes to, a JID; default the brain's reply chat.

risk.description: The run's risk budget; default write.

disallowed_tools.description: Left out, the brain's list; [] allows every tool.

effort.description: Its runs' reasoning effort in Claude mode, in place of the brain's; left out, the brain's. Codex mode keeps codex_effort.

timeout_minutes.description: Stop a run that takes longer, in place of run_timeout_minutes, shorter or longer; 0 is run_timeout_minutes.

missed.description: A run that fell due while the bridge was down: run once on start (the default) or skip it.

jitter_minutes.description: Spread the runs by a fixed offset within this many minutes; left out, schedules.jitter_minutes.

preapproved.description: Steps approved together with the schedule, which its runs take without asking.

github.description: The GitHub access its runs are granted, and no other run: a token for these repositories and permissions, as gh's login, minted as a run starts and ended with it.
